About PDFGirlfriend — free PDF tools and clear answers

What PDFGirlfriend does, who maintains it, and what to expect before choosing a file.

What is PDFGirlfriend?

PDFGirlfriend is a free, source-available browser workspace for merging, extracting, organizing, compressing and converting PDF documents. Processing runs on your device. The application is maintained by Mehbul Islam in India and was previously called iHatePDF and FolioCove PDF. It remains a public beta.

Browse the complete tool catalog and limits · Inspect the source and audit records · Get help or report a problem

Do you upload my documents?

No. PDFGirlfriend has no document-upload endpoint. Selected files are read and processed in your browser. The host receives ordinary requests for the application and sample assets; OCR and browser AI may download models. On-device processing does not mean zero network traffic or independently certified security.

Is it free for work and business documents?

Yes. You may use the official hosted application to process personal or business documents without an app account or document-use fee. Reusing the application code commercially is different: current project-owned code uses PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 and commercial reuse requires separate permission. Read the licensing scope.

Does PDF to Word preserve editable formatting?

No exact editable layout reconstruction is promised. Appearance mode places PDF page images in a DOCX file, preserving visible page appearance without editable text. Text mode extracts editable text with layout loss. Word, Excel and PowerPoint conversion have documented fidelity limits. Choose a conversion by the output you need.

Can PDFGirlfriend work offline?

Offline availability is not guaranteed. Initial application loading, OCR resources and browser-managed models can require a connection. Documents are still processed on-device; needing application assets is different from uploading a document.

Which tools need extra care?

Redaction is experimental and requires independent output inspection. Verified sanitization and validated PDF/A conversion are unavailable. Browser AI requires supported APIs and models. Physical phone camera capture, native mobile downloads and actual Safari-app behavior remain unverified. The beta file limit is 100 MB per file; device memory may impose lower limits. Read the full limitations before processing.

Who can I contact?

Operator: PDFGirlfriend, India. Support: mehbulislam81@gmail.com. Do not send documents, passwords or private information. Support and private security-reporting instructions explain the appropriate channels. No response-time guarantee is offered.
